conditions.start_ect_f: Normal ambient start; warmup to settled operating temperature (180-195 F)
conditions.accessories: Fixed OFF during warmup/baseline (A/C, defrost, blower, headlights OFF)
conditions.upstream_o2: Confirmed active switching upstream O2 sensor retained
conditions.crank_sensor_and_grounds: Unchanged CKP sensor; zero sync drops in v024 and v025 tests

planned_actions: Stage A1: Startup through warm idle; verify Open Loop FMEM remains No and warm idle centers at 950 RPM
Stage A2: Settled warm idle (180-195 F, 60-90s untouched in neutral, clutch up); assess RPM SD (target <= 22 RPM) and STFT (+-5%)
Stage A3: Normal radiator fan cycle (~196 F ON, ~188 F OFF) followed by at least 60 seconds of untouched idle post-fan-off recovery
Stage B1: Parked 1,500 RPM hold (15-20s, TPS ~195 counts); verify Stoich CL active, STFT +-5%, and clean return without lean spike
Stage B2: Parked 2,000 RPM hold (15-20s, TPS ~200 counts); verify Stoich CL active (Closed Loop Active = Yes, Fuel Source = Stoich), STFT +-5%, SCG lambda ~1.00
Stage B3: Parked 2,500 RPM hold (15-20s, TPS ~210 counts); verify Stoich CL active (Closed Loop Active = Yes, Fuel Source = Stoich), STFT +-8%, clean dashpot return to 950 RPM
stop_conditions: Stall or near-stall (<650 RPM), or worsening repeated stumbles relative to v025
Steady warm SCG Lambda > 1.08 for >3 seconds at idle/CL, or steady SCG Lambda > 1.05 for >3 seconds during stationary holds
Warm closed-loop STFT pinned positive (> +18%) or negative (< -20%)
Fuel rail pressure sensor anomaly (FRP collapse or new P0190/P0192/P0193 MIL) or CKP sync fault (P0320)
uncovered_until_tested: Boost operation (>= 1.100 V untouched, not boost-validated)
Full throttle acceleration (>350 counts / >34% TPS open-loop power enrichment transition)
